name: Hurley
band_note: core tee $28 and core blouse $55 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Surf brand: women's bikinis and one-pieces around $44–$95, rashguards and casual clothes alongside its larger men's boardshort range, sold through its own site and stores and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in Huntington Beach, United States in 1999.

quote.q: Born from the beach and built for the future, Hurley is a global apparel and surf brand rooted in innovation, inclusion, and the endless pursuit of fun.

opview: “Born from the beach and built for the future, Hurley is a global apparel and surf brand rooted in innovation, inclusion, and the endless pursuit of fun.” — Hurley (house), About, hurley.com

facts_read.source: brand site (about, terms, women's collection); Bluestar Alliance brand page; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer index; B Lab directory (parent checked); GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Hurley women's apparel (product types 'Womens_*'); EXCLUDED: men's, unisex accessories, swim (priced only for reference), collaborations

doors.note: Not a no-store licence: Hurley's own site locator lists 34 US Hurley stores, all named by place, and 6 are labelled 'Factory'. 33 are at outlet-centre addresses (Cabazon, Camarillo, Carlsbad, Chandler Premium Outlet Way, Citadel, Daytona, Ellenton Factory Shops, Folsom, Fort Worth, Grand Prairie, Houston/Cypress, Jersey Shore Premium Outlets, Las Vegas N & S, Livermore Outlets, Naples/Estero, Ontario Mills, Outlets at Orange, Orlando Intl & Vineland, Pismo, Round Rock, Lehi, San Clemente, San Marcos, San Ysidro, Sawgrass, Silver Sands, Tampa, Texas City, Vacaville, Waikele, West Palm Beach) → outlet. Kissimmee (2661 W. Osceola Parkway) is not an obvious outlet centre, so counted as own-door (unverified venue). More than 25 doors, so counts only. The site doesn't say who runs the stores (brand is under licence).
